title: Practice: Just making the verb perfective

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does по- add in пойти́?
options: added with a hyphen to certain adjectives to create adverbs, often (but not always) with the meaning "in the manner of behaviour, speech etc. of [the adjective]" typically changes the adjective ending to the dative masculine/neuter singular ending, but the following additional changes also occur: -ский to -ски, -ско́й to -ски́, -ий to -ьи
for a while, a little (see delimitative aspect)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists пойти́ under this meaning of по-. Source: Wiktionary, «по-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/по-#Russian).
**пойду** — пойти́ (perfective): to walk; to start, to begin; to function, to work. Wiktionary: по- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **пошёл** — пойти́ (perfective): to walk; to start, to begin; to function, to work. Wiktionary: по- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does за- add in запо́лнить?
options: describing an intensified or extreme action or an action of doing something up to the point that an object becomes junk
describing an action that implies the existence of barriers, obstacles, or hindrance
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists запо́лнить under this meaning of за-. Source: Wiktionary, «за-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to come true, to be fulfilled
(lofty) to announce, to proclaim, to herald
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пойти́ — to walk; запо́лнить — to fill (something to the end); сбы́ться — to come true, to be fulfilled; возвеща́ть — (lofty) to announce, to proclaim, to herald.
